note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 4 impact, local survey_cols I512 I514). The .sav variable labels tie both codes to the form by number and content, 2/2: I512 = "I512. Por causa de la delicuencia su vida sevio afectada - Alarmas" (q.5.12; the trailing "- Alarmas" is a label artifact apparently copied from I51001 and the typos delicuencia/sevio are the label, not the form) and I514 = "I514. Considera Ud. que el tiempo de los medios" (q.5.14). Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.7, checked against the rendered page image, not the terse .sav labels: the 5.12 line-break hyphen sep-tiembre is joined and the double spaces the justified form prints (vida  se, vio  afectada) collapsed; accents as printed; each question is its own item_text (the two stems differ, so instructions is blank, single section); interviewer line MARQUE UN SOLO CODIGO not shipped. Options are the printed sentence completions mucho ? / poco ? / nada ? with the form spacing before the question mark, as in sibling ecuador_2011_safety_avoidance. Resp: form codes and .sav value labels Mucho=1 Poco=2 Nada=3, and the do-file maps Mucho->1 Poco->2 Nada->3 (no recode of direction).
